inputs.text: Job Sikhala is right: people should oppose the proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term to 2030. When those in power invoke “stability” and dismiss public opposition as “posturing,” they risk sidelining people’s political rights to protect executive power. Any lawful process must be open and accountable, not a way to shield the powerful from public scrutiny.

output.main_topic: Opposition to proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term to 2030
